task_instruction: Rewrite each active sentence in the passive voice.
paragraphs: A new high-speed rail line is being prepared for its first full season of service. Engineers review the construction standards before trains begin running. {{red:Contractors must inspect every section of track before opening day.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Technicians can monitor the rail temperature with remote sensors.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:The railway will test the signaling system overnight.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:Workers should clear all tools from the track area.}} {{mask_4}}

The operations team plans how to manage passenger services. {{red:Station staff may guide passengers to the correct platforms.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:The control center will coordinate train movements across the line.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:Maintenance crews must check the overhead power equipment.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:Passengers can buy tickets through the railway website.}} {{mask_8}}

The railway also prepares for delays and changing weather. {{red:Dispatchers will send delay updates to station screens.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:Staff may move a train to a different platform.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:Engineers must examine the bridge after severe weather.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:Inspectors can identify small cracks with specialized equipment.}} {{mask_12}}

Before the launch, the team reviews safety and accessibility features. {{red:Operators should announce important changes clearly.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The railway will provide step-free access at every new station.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:Staff can assist passengers with reduced mobility.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:The control team must report any signal failure immediately.}} {{mask_16}}

On opening day, the railway expects a large number of travelers. {{red:Station managers will open additional ticket gates.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:Passengers should keep their tickets until they leave the station.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:Security staff may inspect large items at the entrance.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The railway will publish service information in several languages.}} {{mask_20}} The new line is designed to connect regional cities with reliable, frequent service.
